en.title: MORE NVDA Pool
en.subtitle: Split tokenized NVDA into a stable side and a leveraged side. sUSD is a $1 claim on the pool. xNVDA takes the rest of the pool value; its leverage changes with the price, and automatic sell and buy zones keep it in a band (shown below, around 2x). xNVDA holders pay funding of 4% per year on the sUSD supply to insurance vault depositors. The insurance vault takes losses before sUSD holders do.
en.descriptions.mintLever: Deposit tNVDA and receive xNVDA, the leveraged side. Its value moves with NVDA at the pool's current leverage, which the sell and buy zones keep in a band. xNVDA pays funding of 4% per year on the sUSD supply, which goes to insurance vault depositors.
en.descriptions.mintStable: Deposit tNVDA and receive sUSD, a $1 claim on the pool. Minting stops if it would push leverage above the cap.
en.descriptions.redeemStable: Burn sUSD for $1 of pool assets each, minus a 0.2% fee, paid in tNVDA (plus mUSDC if the pool holds any). Needs a price less than 24 hours old.
en.descriptions.redeemLever: Burn xNVDA for its current net asset value, minus a 0.2% fee (1% while the pool is in stability mode), paid in tNVDA (plus mUSDC if the pool holds any). Needs a price less than 2 minutes old and stops while the price feed is halted.
en.descriptions.redeemPair: Burn sUSD and xNVDA together in the pool ratio for a pro-rata share of reserves, minus a 0.2% fee. You need both tokens. It needs no price, so it keeps working when the price is stale or the feed is halted.
en.descriptions.insurance: Deposit sUSD into the insurance vault. When the pool sells NVDA to cut leverage, it burns vault sUSD and pays depositors tNVDA at a discount. Depositors also earn sUSD funding. Withdrawals are never locked.
en.quote.feesNow: Mint fees now: sUSD {stable} · xNVDA {lever}. Enter an amount for a quote.
en.quote.insuranceHint: Deposits need an sUSD approval for the insurance vault. Withdrawals and claims need none.
en.quote.approvalNote: If the allowance is too low you approve exactly this amount first (at most {cap} {token} per transaction, never unlimited).
en.quote.maxMintStable: Most tNVDA you can mint into sUSD right now: {amount}
en.faucet.hint: Test collateral: {amount} tNVDA per wallet every {cooldown}.
en.states.walletRequired: Connect a wallet to see balances, the insurance vault position and the faucet.
en.notices.readsUnavailable: Pool data is temporarily unavailable. Retrying every 15 seconds.
en.notices.priceStale: The NVDA price is more than 2 minutes old. Until the next update, mints and xNVDA redeems are blocked. sUSD redeems keep working while the price is less than 24 hours old. Redeem pair and insurance vault withdrawals always work.
en.notices.mintsPaused: Mints are paused (price breaker, halted feed or Guardian). Redeem pair always works. Redeeming sUSD needs a price less than 24 hours old. Redeeming xNVDA needs a price less than 2 minutes old and stops while the feed is halted.
en.notices.stabilityMode: Stability mode: sUSD mints are off, xNVDA mints cost no fee and xNVDA redeems cost 1% until leverage comes down.
en.notices.underwater: The pool is underwater: mints are off and sUSD redeems pay pro rata.
en.notices.wrongNetwork: Your wallet is on another network. Switch to BSC Testnet to continue.
en.notices.network: BSC Testnet only. Test tokens have no value. The NVDA price is relayed to testnet by the MORE team's keeper from the Atlas feed on BSC mainnet. On this testnet deployment the pool admin and the Guardian are one developer wallet of the MORE team, with no timelock delay. It can tune pool parameters (including fees, within the contract limits), change the swap router and pause mints; it cannot pause redeems or insurance vault withdrawals.

zh.title: MORE NVDA 池
zh.subtitle: 把代币化的 NVDA 拆成稳定端和杠杆端。sUSD 是对池子 1 美元的索取权。xNVDA 拿走池子剩余价值；其杠杆随价格变化，自动卖出区和买入区会把它维持在区间内（见下方，约 2 倍）。xNVDA 持有人按 sUSD 供应量每年 4% 支付资金费，付给保险金库存款人。保险金库先于 sUSD 持有人承担损失。
zh.sections.contracts: 预审合约（BSC 测试网，未经审计）
zh.descriptions.mintLever: 存入 tNVDA，获得杠杆端 xNVDA。其价值按池子当前杠杆随 NVDA 波动，卖出区和买入区会把杠杆维持在区间内。xNVDA 按 sUSD 供应量每年 4% 支付资金费，付给保险金库存款人。
zh.descriptions.mintStable: 存入 tNVDA，获得 sUSD，即对池子 1 美元的索取权。若铸造会让杠杆超过上限则会被拒绝。
zh.descriptions.redeemStable: 销毁 sUSD，每个换回价值 1 美元的池内资产（扣除 0.2% 手续费），以 tNVDA 支付（池中有 mUSDC 时也会包含 mUSDC）。需要 24 小时内的价格。
zh.descriptions.redeemLever: 按当前净值销毁 xNVDA（扣除 0.2% 手续费，稳定模式下为 1%），以 tNVDA 支付（池中有 mUSDC 时也会包含 mUSDC）。需要 2 分钟内的价格，喂价暂停期间无法使用。
zh.descriptions.redeemPair: 按池子比例同时销毁 sUSD 和 xNVDA，按比例取回储备（扣除 0.2% 手续费）。需要同时持有两种代币。无需价格，价格过期或喂价暂停时也能使用。
zh.descriptions.insurance: 把 sUSD 存入保险金库。池子卖出 NVDA 降杠杆时，会销毁金库中的 sUSD，并以折扣价向存款人支付 tNVDA。存款人还能获得 sUSD 资金费收益。取款从不锁定。
zh.hints.collateralRatio: 池子价值 / sUSD 供应量
zh.labels.viewTx: 在 BscScan 查看最近一笔交易

zh.quote.feesNow: 当前铸造费：sUSD {stable} · xNVDA {lever}。输入数量查看报价。
zh.quote.insuranceHint: 存款需要先授权保险金库使用 sUSD；取款和领取收益无需授权。
zh.quote.approvalNote: 授权不足时会先按本次数量精确授权（每笔最多 {cap} {token}，绝不无限授权）。
zh.quote.maxMintStable: 当前最多可用 {amount} tNVDA 铸造 sUSD
zh.faucet.hint: 测试抵押品：每个钱包每 {cooldown} 可领 {amount} tNVDA。
zh.states.walletRequired: 连接钱包后可查看余额、保险金库仓位和水龙头。
zh.notices.readsUnavailable: 暂时无法读取池子数据，每 15 秒自动重试。
zh.notices.priceStale: NVDA 价格已超过 2 分钟未更新。下次更新前，无法铸造，也无法赎回 xNVDA。只要价格在 24 小时内，仍可赎回 sUSD。成对赎回和保险金库提款始终可用。
zh.notices.mintsPaused: 铸造已暂停（价格熔断、喂价暂停或 Guardian）。成对赎回始终可用。赎回 sUSD 需要 24 小时内的价格。赎回 xNVDA 需要 2 分钟内的价格，喂价暂停期间无法使用。
zh.notices.stabilityMode: 稳定模式：在杠杆回落前暂停铸造 sUSD，铸造 xNVDA 免手续费，赎回 xNVDA 的手续费为 1%。
zh.notices.underwater: 池子资不抵债：暂停铸造，sUSD 按比例赎回。
zh.notices.wrongNetwork: 钱包当前在其他网络，请切换到 BSC 测试网后继续。
zh.notices.network: 仅限 BSC 测试网，测试代币没有价值。NVDA 价格由 MORE 团队的 keeper 从 BSC 主网的 Atlas 喂价转发到测试网。在本测试网部署中，池子的 admin 和 Guardian 是 MORE 团队的同一个开发者钱包，没有 Timelock 延迟。它可以调整池子参数（包括手续费，不超过合约上限）、更换兑换路由并暂停铸造，但不能暂停赎回或保险金库提款。
